title: Lost Moth Poster
concept: Missing-pet posters appear around town for a moth. A child keeps finding the moth. Each time, the poster updates.
setting: Telephone poles, a laundromat, Iris's bedroom window.
conflict: Iris wants the reward; the posters keep changing to describe her.
escalation: 'LAST SEEN: Laundromat' → 'LAST SEEN: Elm St' → 'LAST SEEN: Her bedroom window'.
reveal: The posters aren't looking for the moth. The moth is looking for Iris; the posters are its notes.
ending: Final poster, with a crayon drawing of Iris: 'FOUND.'
emotional_objective: Playful curiosity that tightens into being hunted. Brand-defining (the moth motif).

hooks.line: Someone in my town is putting up posters for a lost moth.
hooks.first_visual: A taped poster: LOST MOTH, REWARD.

hooks.line: The lost moth poster updated. It knows where I was today.

hooks.first_visual: Child holding a jar with a moth, poster behind.

hooks.line: I found the lost moth. I should not have called the number.
hooks.first_visual: Phone screen dialing; moth in jar.

hooks.line: If you see the lost moth, do not tell it your name.
hooks.first_visual: Handwritten line at bottom of poster.

originality_review: Wholly original; uses MOTHWAKE's own motif, potential recurring element.
